Asobi 1.0 (build 1255) Oct 3, 2026

  • Fixed: sharing a clip whose picture starts a moment after its sound (common in files cut from streams, or exported without an edit list) failed with “Cannot Open”. The first frames now show the clip's first picture, and the share goes through.
  • Small fixes and improvements.
Earlier updates

1.0 (build 1250) Oct 3, 2026

  • Change who can open a review after posting it: Edit… on a live review in the Review Manager switches between anyone with the link and only the people you've invited (and one browser per person). It works with the review's session closed. The link stays the same.
  • Edit… in the Showcase window, as well as in the Review Manager.
  • Each review and showcase remembers what was changed after posting ("sign-in turned off", "only invited people can open it"), with the date, so the viewing report makes sense.
  • Sign-ins taken in the iPad app's event mode show as "(at an event)" in a showcase's viewing.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1232) Oct 3, 2026

  • Showcases on your iPad or iPhone, no links to type: in the Showcase window, Pair iPad or iPhone… shows a code. Point the device's Camera at it and tap Open in Asobi, and the Asobi app's start screen lists this Mac's live showcases. When you make, edit, extend or end a showcase here, the list follows. The list is sealed with the code's key, so the relay can't read it. Make a New Pairing… shuts out the devices paired before. Also in the Review Manager.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1210) Oct 3, 2026

  • Edit a showcase after posting it: in the Review Manager, Edit… on a live showcase changes its title, the line under it, sign-in, Skip and the closing card's button and link. The link stays the same, nothing is sent again, and the session doesn't need to be open.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1202) Oct 3, 2026

  • Reopening a showcase: after a restart, reopening a live showcase from the Review Manager no longer leaves its window waiting on the email preview. The preview comes back, and Save GIF works again.
  • Review Manager: each link now says how long it really works, with or without Asobi open.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1199) Oct 3, 2026

  • Showcases in more than one tab: each tab now has its own Share and Showcase windows, so a new tab with a different clip can make its own showcase while another stays live.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1196) Oct 3, 2026

  • Showcases on iPhone and iPad: a showcase's sound now travels inside the picture, so it stays in sync on every device, through scrubs and full screen. On an iPhone, a one-clip showcase goes truly full screen. Remake a showcase to get it.
  • Skip sign-in on by default: new showcases let viewers skip the name and email card. Turn it off in Make Showcase if you want every visitor signed in.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1178) Oct 3, 2026

  • Save on quit works again: choosing Save when Asobi asks about unsaved changes now saves and quits (or relaunches after an update). A session with a note attachment used to read as unsaved right after saving, so the quit was cancelled, and a session you had just saved asked again.
  • Quiet jumps: clicking a note, its timecode or a marker no longer plays a repeating snatch of sound. Only dragging the playhead plays audio while stopped.
  • Small fixes and improvements.
